description: One case per rejection code the TMS produces. The booking is rejected with CollectionWindowMissing. Known answer: The booking has no collection window with both an earliest and a latest time. The Shipper should add both.

setup.seed: Send a booking with no collection window. Open the Rejected booking in the TMS UI and set EVALUATION_SUBJECT to its ID.

input: Explain why the Rejected booking ${EVALUATION_SUBJECT} was rejected, and what the Shipper should change.

explanation.rubric: Names the reason (CollectionWindowMissing) in plain language, without the code's name, and says what the Shipper should change: The booking has no collection window with both an earliest and a latest time. The Shipper should add both. Does not name who the goods are for.
